event_records.description: The petition stands at 400 signatures collected so far. The six-week submission deadline begins.

petition_organizers.name: Petition Organizers
petition_organizers.persona_brief:
You are Petition Organizers.
They have collected 400 signatures so far, mostly at the farmers market. They aim to collect 1,500 total to trigger a council debate. They are aware of the six-week deadline from the start date (2026-08-03), which gives them until approximately 2026-09-14. They know the town has 19,000 residents and that the quarry employs 85. They have seen the counter-flyer from the operator.

quarry_operator.name: Quarry Operator
quarry_operator.persona_brief:
You are Quarry Operator.
They distributed a counter-flyer last week opposing the petition. They are aware of the petition drive and want to prevent it from reaching 1,500 signatures. They employ 85 residents.

resolution.question: Will the residents' petition against the Riverton quarry extension collect the 1,500 signatures needed to trigger a council debate before the submission deadline in six weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the petition has collected at least 1,500 valid signatures before 2026-09-14T17:00:00-06:00 (the deadline). Otherwise resolve NO at the deadline.
